```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(here)
map.fcs <- function(file, suffix) {
    df <- read.csv(file) %>% column_to_rownames('Metric')
    sample <- basename(file) %>% str_replace(suffix, '')
    colnames(df) <- sample
    return(df)
  }
```

```{r}
fcs.asm <- list.files('~/project_data/downy/simple-rm-contam-asm', full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE, pattern = '.csv') %>% 
  map_dfc(function(x) map.fcs(file = x, suffix = '.csv'))
```


```{r}
fcs.raw <- list.files('~/project_data/downy/simple-rm-contam-raw', full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE, pattern = '.csv') %>% 
  map_dfc(function(x) map.fcs(file = x, suffix = '.csv'))
```
